Equilibrium temperature scales as T ∝ 1/√a (for same albedo and star).

So T1/T2 = √(a2/a1) = 1.4 → a2/a1 = 1.96
T2/T3 = √(a3/a2) = 2.3 → a3/a2 = 5.29

Therefore a3/a1 = 1.96 × 5.29 = 10.37

Period: P ∝ a^(3/2)

P3/P1 = (a3/a1)^(3/2) = (10.37)^(3/2)

10.37^(3/2) = 10.37 × √10.37 = 10.37 × 3.220 = 33.4

The mass information is a distractor (only needed if we were computing something else).

Answer: D
